correctness.rationale: The frozen mathematics is sound, and the replacement RESULT.md and SLOGAN.txt were checked as the final claim. A nonsurjective quaternion endomorphism has abelian image and kills the centre (the commutator); every square is central, so its image lies in {±1}. This gives four characters, all trivial on the centre. The images of i and j in an automorphism are nonparallel signed units, giving 24 choices, identified with the orientation-preserving signed permutations of the imaginary axes, acting faithfully on the four unoriented cube diagonals. In the product-alphabet local homomorphism the coordinate factors commute pairwise, allowing at most one surjective factor. If there is one, shift it to the origin; every other factor is a central character. Characters ignore central twists, so the offsite shears add and square to the identity. Coordinate restrictions recover every parameter uniquely; conjugation by an alphabet automorphism acts by precomposing characters with its inverse. For a central map C_d and a unit F=S^k A_alpha H_c, composing on the left gives F C_d=S^k C_d because the normalized unit fixes the central shift; on the right C_d F=S^k C_(d composed with alpha) since characters ignore twists. Two central factors compose to zero. For the normalized order, the shear conjugates are summed by powers of the quotient action rho: if the alphabet order is 2 or 4 the four terms cancel in pairs since rho^2=1; for order 3 the action still has order 3 because the kernel has order 4, and 1+rho+rho^2=0 by invertibility of 1-rho. The alphabet identity case is immediate. Pure alphabet automorphisms realize each order, and a wrong drift acts by a nonzero shift on the whole central subshift. Entropy follows by passing to a finite power, and the count and idempotents follow from the two disjoint classes. The supplied finite checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: No finite-ring corroboration substitutes for the product-local proof. Arbitrary cellular automata not preserving quaternion multiplication are out of scope.

value.rationale: The repaired result gives explicit compositional structure for a natural nonabelian full shift, not just a surjective test, and resolves the possible time orders after removing spatial drift. In particular the quaternion geometry improves the generic 2t power bound in a way that distinguishes which time orders can actually occur, and the square-zero ideal and absorption formulas make the full classification usable under composition. The already-covered entropy and reversible census are consequences for context rather than the basis of the value assessment.
residual_risks: The statement is specific to Q8; it does not classify individual conjugacy classes or extend the sharp four-step bound to other alphabets.
